import{useEffect,useState}from"react";import{supabase}from"../lib/supabase";import fallbackPrices from"../data/fallbackPrices";export default function useScrapPrices(){const[prices,setPrices]=useState(fallbackPrices);// ← instant load
useEffect(()=>{async function fetchPrices(){try{const{data,error}=await supabase.from("scrap_prices").select("*").order("display_order",{ascending:true});if(!error&&data){setPrices(data);}}catch(err){console.error("Supabase failed, using fallback data");}}fetchPrices();},[]);return prices;}
